scripts.test:sessions: bun test test/pilotChat.test.ts test/pilotProviders.test.ts test/pilotAccess.test.ts test/pilotWorkMigration.test.ts test/pilotOnly.test.ts
scripts.web:build: cd web/ui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx --no-install vite build
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings bin lib web integrations clients site test packages
scripts.ci:checks: bun run ci:static && bun run test
scripts.ci:static: bun run plugins:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run web:build && bun run --cwd web/ui check
scripts.ci:browser: bun run web:build && bun test test/siteBuild.test.ts && node bin/ci-browser.cjs
scripts.ci:stress: bun test test/gardenerProgress.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'the real filesystem watcher' --rerun-each 100
